included: AutoCAD core commands documented in Autodesk AutoCAD 2027 Help

executionPolicy.preferredScriptForm: Use the global English full command name: _.COMMAND. For prompt-only variants use _.-COMMAND.

-3DOSNAP.description: Uses command prompts to set running object snap modes for 3D objects.

-ACTSTOP.description: Stops the Action Recorder and, from the command line, provides the option of saving the recorded actions to an action macro file

-ACTUSERMESSAGE.description: From the command line, inserts a user message into an action macro.

-ARCHIVE.description: From the command prompt, packages the current sheet set files for storage.

-ARRAY.description: From the command line, creates copies of objects arranged in a pattern.

-ATTACH.description: From the Command prompt, inserts references to external files such as other drawings, raster images, point clouds, coordination models, and underlays.

-ATTDEF.description: At the Command prompt, creates an attribute definition for storing data in a block.

-ATTEDIT.description: At the Command prompt, changes attribute information in a block.

-ATTEXT.description: From the Command prompt, extracts attribute data, informational text associated with a block, into a file.

-BCPARAMETER.description: Applies constraint parameters to selected objects, or converts dimensional constraints to parameter constraints.

-BEDIT.description: Opens the block definition in the Block Editor from the Command prompt.

-BLOCK.description: At the Command prompt, creates a block definition from selected objects.

-BOUNDARY.description: At the Command prompt, creates regions or polylines from enclosed areas.

-BREPLACE.description: At the Command prompt, replaces specified block references with a different block.

-BSEARCH.description: At the Command prompt, converts the selected entities and identical instances into blocks.

-BVSTATE.description: At the command prompt, creates, sets, or deletes a visibility state in a dynamic block.

-COLOR.description: Sets the color for new objects from the Command prompt.

-COMPARE.description: At the Command prompt, compares a specified drawing to the current drawing.

-COORDINATIONMODELATTACH.description: From the Command prompt, inserts references to coordination models such as NWD and NWC Navisworks files.

-COPYTOLAYER.description: Copies one or more objects to another layer from the Command prompt.

-DATAEXTRACTION.description: Extracts data as specified in an existing attribute extraction template (BLK) file or data extraction (DXE or DXEX) file.

-DGNATTACH.description: Attach a DGN underlay from the command line.

-DGNBIND.description: Binds DGN underlays to the current drawing.

-DGNEXPORT.description: At the Command prompt, creates one or more DGN files from the current drawing.

-DGNIMPORT.description: At the Command prompt, imports data from DGN files.

-DIMINSPECT.description: From the Command prompt, adds or removes inspection information from a selected dimension.

-DIMSTYLE.description: At the Command prompt, creates and modifies dimension styles.

-DWFATTACH.description: From the Command prompt, attach a DWF underlay.

-EATTEXT.description: From the Command line, extracts data as specified in an existing attribute extraction template (BLK) file or data extraction (DXE or DXEX) file.

-ETRANSMIT.description: From the Command line, packages a set of files for internet transmission.

-EXPORT.description: Creates a DWF, DWFx, or PDF file from the command line.

-FIND.description: Searches for the text that you specify in the entire drawing, the current space or layout, or selected objects.

-GRAPHICSCONFIG.description: Sets hardware acceleration on or off and provides access to display performance options on the command line.

-GROUP.description: Creates and manages saved sets of objects called groups.

-HATCH.description: Uses command prompts to fill an enclosed area or selected objects with a hatch pattern, solid fill, or gradient fill.

-HATCHEDIT.description: From the Command prompt, modifies existing hatches or fills.

-HYPERLINK.description: From the Command prompt, inserts and removes hyperlinks from areas or to selected objects.

-IMAGE.description: Attaches a raster image to the drawing.

-IMAGEADJUST.description: Controls the brightness, contrast, and fade values of images.

-INPUTSEARCHOPTIONS.description: From the command line, controls settings for display of the command line suggestion list for commands, system variables, and named objects.

-INSERT.description: Inserts a block or drawing into the current drawing.

-INSERTCONTENT.description: Inserts a drawing or block into the current drawing.

-INTERFERE.description: At the Command prompt, creates a temporary 3D solid from the interferences between two sets of selected 3D solids

-LAYDEL.description: At the Command prompt, deletes all objects on a layer and purges the layer.

-LAYMCH.description: Changes the layer of a selected object to match the layer of a selected object.

-LAYMRG.description: At the Command prompt, merges selected layers into a target layer.

-LINETYPE.description: At the Command prompt, loads, sets, and modifies linetypes.

-LWEIGHT.description: Sets the current lineweight, lineweight display options, and lineweight units.

-MARKUPASSIST.description: At the Command prompt, analyzes an imported markup and can help place text callouts and revision clouds faster and with less manual effort.

-MARKUPIMPORT.description: At the command prompt, imports a marked up drawing (image/pdf) in-place into your DWG as a new trace.

-MLEDIT.description: Edits multiline intersections, breaks, and vertices.

-OBJECTSCALE.description: From the Command prompt, adds or deletes supported scales for annotative objects.

-OVERKILL.description: Removes duplicate or overlapping lines, arcs, and polylines. Also, combines partially overlapping or contiguous ones.

-PAGESETUP.description: Modifies the current page layout settings for the plotting device, paper size, plot scale, and several other settings in the command line.

-PAN.description: Shifts the view by specifying up to two points to determine a distance and direction.

-PARAMETERS.description: Opens the Parameters Manager palette that includes all dimensional constraint parameters, reference parameters, and user variables in the current drawing.

-PARTIALOAD.description: Loads additional geometry into a partially opened drawing from the command line.

-PDFATTACH.description: Attach a PDF underlay from the command line.

-PDFIMPORT.description: Imports the objects in a PDF file or an attached PDF underlay from the command line.

-PDFSHXTEXT.description: Converts the SHX geometry imported from PDF files into individual multiline text objects from the command line.

-PLOT.description: Plots a drawing to a plotter, printer, or file in the command line.

-PLOTSTAMP.description: Places a plot stamp on a specified corner of each drawing and logs it to a file.

-PLOTSTYLE.description: Lists all available plotstyles in the current drawing and to set a plotstyle current.

-POINTCLOUDATTACH.description: Inserts a point cloud file into the current drawing from the Command prompt.

-PSETUPIN.description: Imports a user-defined page setup into a new drawing layout using the command line.

-PUBLISH.description: Publishes drawings to DWF, DWFx, and PDF files, or to printers or plotters using the command line.

-PURGE.description: Removes unused named objects, such as block definitions and layers, from the current drawing using the command line.

-REFEDIT.description: Edits an xref or a block definition directly within the current drawing.

-RENAME.description: Changes the names assigned to named objects from the Command prompt.

-RENDER.description: Creates a photorealistic or realistically shaded image of a 3D solid or surface model from the Command prompt.

-SCALELISTEDIT.description: Controls the list of scales available for layout viewports, page layouts, and plotting.

-SHADEMODE.description: Provides simple shading for 3D solids and surfaces.

-STYLE.description: Creates, modifies, or specifies text styles.

-TOOLBAR.description: Displays, hides, and customizes toolbars from the Command prompt.

-UNITS.description: Controls the precision and display formats for coordinates, distances, and angles.

-VBARUN.description: Runs a VBA macro from the Command prompt.

-VIEW.description: Saves and restores named model space views, layout views, and preset views from the Command prompt.

-VISUALSTYLES.description: Creates and modifies visual styles from the command line.

-VPOINT.description: Sets the viewing direction for a 3D visualization of the drawing.

-VPORTS.description: Creates multiple viewports in model space or paper space.

cuixMacroRefs.name: Remove Viewport Overrides for All Layers

-WBLOCK.description: Saves selected objects or converts a block to a specified drawing file.

-XBIND.description: Binds one or more definitions of named objects in an xref to the current drawing.

-XREF.description: From the Command prompt, manages drawings inserted as external references (xrefs).

+CONSTRAINTSETTINGS.description: Displays the Constraint Settings dialog box with a specific tab set current.

3DALIGN.description: Aligns objects with other objects in 2D and 3D.

3DARRAY.description: Creates nonassociative, 3D rectangular or polar arrays.

3DCLIP.description: Opens the Adjust Clipping Planes window, where you can specify what portions of a 3D model to display.

3DCORBIT.description: Rotates the view in 3D space with continuous motion.

3DDISTANCE.description: Starts the interactive 3D view and makes objects appear closer or farther away.

3DDWF.description: Creates a 3D DWF or 3D DWFx file of your 3D model and displays it in the DWF Viewer.

3DEDITBAR.description: Reshapes splines and NURBS surfaces, including their tangency properties.

3DFACE.description: Creates a three-sided or four-sided surface in 3D space.

3DFLY.description: Changes the 3D view in a drawing interactively to create the appearance of flying through the model.

3DFORBIT.description: Rotates the view in 3D space without constraining roll.

3DMOVE.description: In a 3D view, displays the 3D Move gizmo to aid in moving 3D objects a specified distance in a specified direction.

3DORBIT.description: Provides interactive viewing in 3D with the mouse. Right-click to display viewing options.

3DORBITCTR.description: Sets a specific center of rotation in 3D Orbit view.

3DOSNAP.description: Sets the object snap modes for 3D objects.

3DPAN.description: Shifts the view without changing the viewing direction or magnification.

3DPRINT.description: Specifies 3D Plot settings, and prepares your drawing for 3D printing.

3DPRINTSERVICE.description: Creates an STL file that can be sent to a 3D printing service.

3DROTATE.description: In a 3D view, displays the 3D Rotate gizmo to aid in revolving 3D objects around a base point.

3DSCALE.description: In a 3D view, displays the 3D Scale gizmo to aid in resizing 3D objects.

3DSWIVEL.description: Changes the target of the view in the direction that you drag.

3DWALK.description: Changes the 3D view in a drawing interactively to create the appearance of walking through the model.

3DZOOM.description: Zooms in and out in a perspective view.

ACISIN.description: Imports an ACIS (SAT) file and creates 3D solid, body, or region objects.

ACISOUT.description: Exports 3D solid, region, or body objects to an ACIS file.

ACTBASEPOINT.description: Inserts a base point or base point prompt in an action macro.

ACTIVITYINSIGHTSCLOSE.description: Closes the Activity Insights palette which displays activities for the current drawing.

ACTIVITYINSIGHTSOPEN.description: Opens the Activity Insights palette to view activities for the current drawing.

ACTRECORD.description: Starts the recording an action macro.

ACTSTOP.description: Stops the Action Recorder and provides the option of saving the recorded actions to an action macro file.

ACTUSERINPUT.description: Pauses for user input in an action macro.

ACTUSERMESSAGE.description: Inserts a user message into an action macro.

ADCENTER.description: Manages and inserts content such as blocks, xrefs, and hatch patterns.

ADCNAVIGATE.description: Loads a specified drawing file, folder, or network path in the DesignCenter Folders tab.

ADDSELECTED.description: Creates a new object of the same type and general properties as a selected object, but with different geometric values.

ADJUST.description: Adjusts the fade, contrast and monochrome settings of the selected underlay (DWF, DWFx, PDF, or DGN), or image.

ALIGN.description: Aligns objects with other objects in 2D and 3D.

AMECONVERT.description: Converts AME solid models to AutoCAD solid objects.

ANALYSISCURVATURE.description: Displays a color gradient onto a surface to evaluate different aspects of its curvature.

ANALYSISDRAFT.description: Displays a color gradient onto a 3D model to evaluate whether there is adequate space between a part and its mold.

ANALYSISOPTIONS.description: Sets the display options for zebra, curvature, and draft analysis.

ANALYSISZEBRA.description: Projects stripes onto a 3D model to analyze surface continuity.

ANIPATH.description: Saves an animation of a camera moving or panning in a 3D model.

ANNORESET.description: Resets the locations of all alternate scale representations of the selected annotative objects.

ANNOUPDATE.description: Updates existing annotative objects to match the current properties of their styles.

APERTURE.description: Controls the size of the object snap target box.

APPAUTOLOADER.description: Lists or reloads all plug-ins in the application plug-in folder.

APPLOAD.description: Loads and unloads applications and defines which applications to load at startup.

APPSTORE.description: Opens the Autodesk App Store website.

ARCHIVE.description: Packages the current sheet set files for storage.

AREA.description: Calculates the area and perimeter of objects or of defined areas.

ARRAY.description: Creates copies of objects arranged in a pattern.

ARRAYCLASSIC.description: Creates arrays using the legacy dialog box.

ARRAYCLOSE.description: Saves or discards changes made to an array's source objects and exits the array editing state.

ARRAYEDIT.description: Edits associative array objects and their source objects.

ARRAYPATH.description: Evenly distributes object copies along a path or a portion of a path.

ARRAYPOLAR.description: Evenly distributes object copies in a circular pattern around a center point or axis of rotation.

ARRAYRECT.description: Distributes object copies into any combination of rows, columns, and levels.

ARX.description: Loads, unloads, and provides information about ObjectARX applications.

ASSISTANTCLOSE.description: Closes Autodesk Assistant which displays links to help related content from several sources along with an option to contact support.

ASSISTANTOPEN.description: Displays Autodesk Assistant, which provides AI-guided help.

ATTACH.description: Inserts references to external files such as other drawings, raster images, point clouds, coordination models, and underlays.

ATTACHURL.description: Attaches hyperlinks to objects or areas in a drawing.

ATTDEF.description: Creates an attribute definition for storing data in a block.

ATTDISP.description: Controls the visibility overrides for all block attributes in a drawing.

ATTEDIT.description: Changes attribute information in a block.

ATTEXT.description: Extracts attribute data, informational text associated with a block, into a file.

ATTIPEDIT.description: Changes the textual content of an attribute within a block.

ATTREDEF.description: Redefines a block and updates associated attributes.

ATTSYNC.description: Applies attribute changes in a block definition to all block references.

AUDIT.description: Evaluates the integrity of a drawing and corrects some errors.

AUTOCONSTRAIN.description: Applies geometric constraints to a selection set of objects based on orientation of the objects relative to one another.

AUTOPUBLISH.description: Publishes drawings to DWF, DWFx, or PDF files automatically to a specified location.

BACTION.description: Adds an action to a dynamic block definition.

BACTIONBAR.description: Displays or hides action bars for a selection set of parameter objects.

BACTIONSET.description: Specifies the selection set of objects associated with an action in a dynamic block definition.

BACTIONTOOL.description: Adds an action to a dynamic block definition.

BASE.description: Sets the insertion base point for the current drawing.

BASSOCIATE.description: Associates an action with a parameter in a dynamic block definition.

BATTMAN.description: Manages the attributes for a selected block definition.

BATTORDER.description: Specifies the order of attributes for a block.

BAUTHORPALETTE.description: Opens the Block Authoring Palettes window in the Block Editor.

BAUTHORPALETTECLOSE.description: Closes the Block Authoring Palettes window in the Block Editor.

BCONSTRUCTION.description: Converts block geometry into construction geometry, which may be hidden or displayed.

BCPARAMETER.description: Applies constraint parameters to selected objects, or converts dimensional constraints to parameter constraints.

BCYCLEORDER.description: Changes the cycling order of grips for a dynamic block reference.

BDETECT.description: Displays the Detect palette where you can start object detection and manage the objects that are eligible for conversion.

BEDIT.description: Opens the block definition in the Block Editor.

BESETTINGS.description: Displays the Block Editor Settings dialog box.

BGRIPSET.description: Creates, deletes, or resets grips associated with a parameter.

BLEND.description: Creates a spline in the gap between two selected lines or curves.

BLOCK.description: Creates a block definition from selected objects.

BLOCKICON.description: Generates preview images for blocks displayed in DesignCenter.

BLOCKSDATAOPTION.description: Displays the data collection consent dialog box.

BLOCKSPALETTE.description: Displays the Blocks palette, which you can use to insert blocks and drawings into the current drawing.

BLOOKUPTABLE.description: Displays or creates a lookup table for a dynamic block definition.

BMPOUT.description: Saves selected objects to a file in device-independent bitmap format.

BOUNDARY.description: Creates regions or a polylines from enclosed areas.

BPARAMETER.description: Adds a parameter with grips to a dynamic block definition.

BREAK.description: Breaks the selected object between two points.

BREAKATPOINT.description: Breaks the selected object into two objects at a specified point.

BREP.description: Removes the history from 3D solids and composite solids, and associativity from surfaces.

BREPLACE.description: Replaces specified block references with a different block.

BROWSER.description: Launches the default web browser defined in your system's registry.

BSAVEAS.description: Saves a copy of the current block definition under a new name.

BSEARCH.description: Displays the Convert dialog box, which provides options to convert selected entities and identical instances into blocks.

BTABLE.description: Stores variations of a block in the Block Properties Table.

BTESTBLOCK.description: Displays a window within the Block Editor to test a dynamic block.

BVHIDE.description: Makes objects invisible in the current visibility state or all visibility states in a dynamic block definition.

BVSHOW.description: Makes objects visible in the current visibility state or all visibility states in a dynamic block definition.

BVSTATE.description: Creates, sets, or deletes a visibility state in a dynamic block.

CAL.description: Evaluates mathematical and geometric expressions at the Command prompt or within a command.

CAMERA.description: Sets a camera and target location to create and save a 3D perspective view of objects.

CENTERDISASSOCIATE.description: Removes associativity of center marks or centerlines from objects they define.

CENTERLINE.description: Creates centerline geometry associated with selected lines and linear polyline segments.

CENTERMARK.description: Creates an associative, cross-shaped mark at the center of a selected circle or arc.

CENTERREASSOCIATE.description: Associates or reassociates a center mark or centerline object to selected objects.

CENTERRESET.description: Resets the centerlines to the current value specified in the CENTEREXE system variable.

CHAMFER.description: Bevels or chamfers the edges of two 2D objects or the adjacent faces of a 3D solid.

CHAMFEREDGE.description: Bevels the edges of 3D solids and surfaces.

CHANGE.description: Changes the properties of existing objects.

CHECKOUT.description: Check out and modify selected geometry in the Trace workspace while a collaborator has the drawing open. When finished, submit your changes for approval.

CHECKSTANDARDS.description: Checks the current drawing for standards violations.

CHPROP.description: Changes the properties of an object.

CHSPACE.description: On a layout, transfers selected objects between model space and paper space.

CLASSICGROUP.description: Opens the legacy Object Grouping dialog box.

CLASSICIMAGE.description: Manages referenced image files in the current drawing.

CLASSICINSERT.description: Inserts a block or drawing into the current drawing using the classic version of the INSERT command.

CLASSICLAYER.description: Opens the legacy Layer Properties Manager.

CLASSICXREF.description: Manages referenced drawing files in the current drawing.

CLEANSCREENOFF.description: Restores the state of the display before CLEANSCREENON was used.

CLEANSCREENON.description: Clears the screen of toolbars and dockable windows, excluding the command window.

CLIP.description: Crops selected objects such as blocks, external references, images, viewports, and underlays to a specified boundary.

CLOSEALLOTHER.description: Closes all other open drawings, except the current drawing.

COLOR.description: Sets the color for new objects.

COMMANDMACROS.description: Opens the Command Macros palette from which you can manage and use command macro recommendations.

COMPARE.description: Compares a specified drawing file with the current drawing file, highlighting the differences with color within revision clouds.

COMPARECLOSE.description: Closes the DWG Compare toolbar and ends the comparison.

COMPAREEXPORT.description: Exports the results of the comparison into a new drawing file, called a snapshot drawing.

COMPAREIMPORT.description: Imports objects from the compared drawing into the current drawing.

COMPAREINFO.description: Provides a way to insert or copy the property information about the two compared drawing files.

COMPILE.description: Compiles shape files and PostScript font files into SHX files.

CONSTRAINTBAR.description: Displays or hides the geometric constraints on an object.

CONSTRAINTSETTINGS.description: Controls the display of geometric constraints on constraint bars.

CONVERT.description: Converts "legacy" 2D polylines and hatches for use with later product releases.

CONVERTCTB.description: Converts a color-dependent plot style table (CTB) to a named plot style table (STB).

CONVERTOLDLIGHTS.description: Converts lights created in previous drawing file formats to the current format.

CONVERTOLDMATERIALS.description: Converts older materials to use the current materials format.

CONVERTPOLY.description: Converts 2D polylines between the "legacy" heavy and optimized lightweight formats.

CONVERTPSTYLES.description: Converts the current drawing to either named or color-dependent plot styles.

CONVTOMESH.description: Converts 3D objects such as polygon meshes, surfaces, and solids to mesh objects.

CONVTONURBS.description: Converts 3D solids and surfaces into NURBS surfaces.

COORDINATIONMODELATTACH.description: Inserts references to coordination models such as NWD and NWC Navisworks files.

COPY.description: Copies objects a specified distance in a specified direction.

COPYBASE.description: Copies selected objects to the Clipboard along with a specified base point.

COPYCLIP.description: Copies selected objects to the Clipboard.

COPYFROMTRACE.description: Copies objects from a trace into the drawing.

COPYHIST.description: Copies the text in the command line history to the Clipboard.

COPYLINK.description: Copies the current view to the Clipboard for linking to other OLE applications.

COPYTOLAYER.description: Copies one or more objects to another layer.

cuixMacroRefs.name: Layer, Copy Objects to New Layer

COUNT.description: Counts and highlights the instances of the selected object in the drawing.

COUNTAREA.description: Defines the area to count the instances of an object or block.

COUNTCLOSE.description: Closes the Count toolbar and exits the count.

COUNTFIELD.description: Creates a field that's set to the value of the current count.

COUNTLIST.description: Opens the Count palette to display and manage the counted blocks.

COUNTNAVNEXT.description: Zooms to the next object in the count result.

COUNTNAVPREV.description: Zooms to the previous object in the count result.

COUNTTABLE.description: Inserts a table containing the block names and the corresponding count of each block in the drawing.

CUI.description: Manages the customized user interface elements in the product.

CUIEXPORT.description: Exports customized settings from the main CUIx file to an enterprise or partial CUIx file.

CUIIMPORT.description: Imports customized settings from an enterprise or partial CUIx file to the main CUIx file.

CUSTOMIZE.description: Customizes tool palettes and tool palette groups.

CUTBASE.description: Copies selected objects to the Clipboard, along with a specified base point, and removes them from the drawing.

CUTCLIP.description: Copies selected objects to the Clipboard and removes them from the drawing.

CVADD.description: Adds control vertices to NURBS surfaces and splines.

CVHIDE.description: Turns off the display of control vertices for all NURBS surfaces and curves.

CVREBUILD.description: Rebuilds the shape of NURBS surfaces and curves.

CVREMOVE.description: Removes control vertices from NURBS surfaces and curves.

CVSHOW.description: Displays the control vertices for specified NURBS surfaces or curves.

DATAEXTRACTION.description: Extracts drawing data and merges data from an external source to a data extraction table or external file.

DATALINK.description: Displays the Data Link dialog box.

DATALINKUPDATE.description: Updates data to or from an established external data link.

DBCCLOSE.description: Closes the Select Data Object dialog box (dbConnect Manager).

DBCCONFIGURE.description: Opens the Configure a Data Source dialog box (dbConnect Manager)

DBCDEFINELLT.description: Opens the Select a Database Object dialog box.

DBCDEFINELT.description: Opens the Select Data Object Dialog Box (dbConnect Manager)

DBCONNECT.description: Provides an interface to external database tables.

DBLIST.description: Lists database information for each object in the drawing.

DCALIGNED.description: Constrains the distance between two points on different objects.

DCANGULAR.description: Constrains the angle between line or polyline segments, the angle swept out by an arc or a polyline arc segment, or the angle between three points on objects.

DCCONVERT.description: Converts associative dimensions to dimensional constraints.

DCDIAMETER.description: Constrains the diameter of a circle or an arc.

DCDISPLAY.description: Displays or hides the dynamic constraints associated with a selection set of objects.

DCFORM.description: Specifies whether the dimensional constraint being created is dynamic or annotational.

DCHORIZONTAL.description: Constrains the X distance between points on an object, or between two points on different objects.

DCLINEAR.description: Creates a horizontal, vertical, or rotated constraint based on the locations of the extension line origins and the dimension line.

DCRADIUS.description: Constrains the radius of a circle or an arc.

DCVERTICAL.description: Constrains the Y distance between points on an object, or between two points on different objects.

DELAY.description: Provides a timed pause within a script.

DELCONSTRAINT.description: Removes all geometric and dimensional constraints from a selection set of objects.

DETECTCONVERT.description: Displays the Convert dialog box, which provides options to convert the detected objects and instances into blocks.

DETECTPRIMARY.description: Specifies the detected instance from which a new block definition is created.

DETECTREMOVE.description: Removes selected instances from the set.

DETECTREVIEWNEXT.description: Displays the next set of detected objects.

DETECTREVIEWPREV.description: Displays the previous set of detected objects.

DGNADJUST.description: Adjust the fade, contrast, and monochrome settings of a DGN underlay.

DGNATTACH.description: Inserts a DGN file as an underlay into the current drawing.

DGNCLIP.description: Crops the display of a selected DGN underlay to a specified boundary.

DGNEXPORT.description: Creates one or more DGN files from the current drawing.

DGNIMPORT.description: Imports the data from a DGN file into a new DWG file or the current DWG file, depending on the DGNIMPORTMODE system variable.

DGNLAYERS.description: Controls the display of layers in a DGN underlay.

DGNMAPPING.description: Allows users to create and edit user-defined DGN mapping setups.

DIGITALSIGN.description: Attaches a digital signature to a drawing, which is removed if an unauthorized change is made.

DIM.description: Creates multiple dimensions and types of dimensions with a single command.

DIMBASELINE.description: Creates a linear, angular, or ordinate dimension from the baseline of the previous or selected dimension.

DIMBREAK.description: Breaks or restores dimension and extension lines where they cross other objects.

DIMCENTER.description: Creates the non-associative center mark or the centerlines of circles and arcs.

DIMCONSTRAINT.description: Applies dimensional constraints to selected objects or points on objects, or converts associative dimensions to dimensional constraints.

DIMCONTINUE.description: Creates a dimension that starts from an extension line of the previous or selected dimension.

DIMDIAMETER.description: Creates a diameter dimension for a circle or an arc.

DIMEDIT.description: Edits dimension text and extension lines.

DIMINSPECT.description: Adds or removes inspection information for a selected dimension.

DIMJOGGED.description: Creates jogged dimensions for circles and arcs.

DIMJOGLINE.description: Adds or removes a jog line on a linear or aligned dimension.

DIMOVERRIDE.description: Controls overrides of system variables used in selected dimensions.

DIMRADIUS.description: Creates a radius dimension for a circle or an arc.

DIMREASSOCIATE.description: Associates or reassociates selected dimensions to objects or points on objects.

DIMREGEN.description: Updates the locations of all associative dimensions.

DIMSPACE.description: Adjusts the spacing between linear dimensions or angular dimensions.

DIMTEDIT.description: Moves and rotates dimension text and relocates the dimension line.

DIST.description: Measures the distance and angle between two points.

DIVIDE.description: Creates evenly spaced point objects or blocks along the length or perimeter of an object.

DONUT.description: Creates a filled circle or a wide ring.

DOWNLOADMANAGER.description: Reports the status of the of the current download.

DRAGMODE.description: Controls the way dragged objects are displayed.

DRAWINGRECOVERY.description: Displays a list of drawing files that can be recovered after a program or system failure.

DRAWORDER.description: Changes the draw order of images and other objects.

DSETTINGS.description: Sets grid and snap, polar and object snap tracking, object snap modes, Dynamic Input, and Quick Properties.

DVIEW.description: Defines parallel projection or perspective views by using a camera and target.

DWFADJUST.description: Adjust the fade, contrast, and monochrome settings of a DWF or DWFx underlay.

DWFATTACH.description: Inserts a DWF or DWFx file as an underlay into the current drawing.

DWFCLIP.description: Crops the display of a selected DWF or DWFx underlay to a specified boundary.

DWFFORMAT.description: Sets the default format to DWF or DWFx for output in specific commands.

DWFLAYERS.description: Controls the display of layers in a DWF or DWFx underlay.

DWGCONVERT.description: Converts drawing format version for selected drawing files.

DWGPROPS.description: Sets and displays the file properties of the current drawing.

DXBIN.description: Imports an AutoCAD DXB (drawing interchange binary) file.

EATTEDIT.description: Edits attributes in a block reference.

EATTEXT.description: Exports block attribute information to a table or to an external file.

EDGE.description: Changes the visibility of 3D face edges.

EDGESURF.description: Creates a mesh between four contiguous edges or curves.

EDITSHOT.description: Edits a saved named view with or without motion.

ELEV.description: Sets elevation and extrusion thickness of new objects.

ELLIPSE.description: Creates an ellipse or an elliptical arc.

ETRANSMIT.description: Packages a set of files for Internet transmission.

EXPLODE.description: Breaks a compound object into its component objects.

EXPORT.description: Saves the objects in a drawing to a different file format.

EXPORTDWF.description: Creates a DWF file and allows you to set individual page setup overrides on a sheet-by-sheet basis.

EXPORTDWFX.description: Creates a DWFx file where you can set individual page setup overrides on a sheet-by-sheet basis.

EXPORTLAYOUT.description: Creates a visual representation of the current layout in the model space of a new drawing.

EXPORTPDF.description: Generates a PDF file from a single layout, all layouts, or a specified area in model space.

EXPORTSETTINGS.description: Adjusts the page setup and drawing selection when exporting to a DWF, DWFx, or PDF file.

EXPORTTOAUTOCAD.description: Creates a version of a drawing file that can be opened in products such as AutoCAD and previous releases of a toolset.

EXTEND.description: Extends objects to meet the edges of other objects.

EXTRUDE.description: Creates a 3D solid from an object that encloses an area, or a 3D surface from an object with open ends.

FADEMARKUP.description: Fade individual markups so they are less visible on a trace.

FIELD.description: Creates a multiline text object with a field that can be updated automatically as the field value changes.

FILETAB.description: Displays the file tabs at the top of the drawing area.

FILETABCLOSE.description: Hides the file tabs at the top of the drawing area.

FILL.description: Controls the display of filled objects such as hatches, 2D solids, and wide polylines.

FILLET.description: Rounds or fillets the edges of two 2D objects or the adjacent faces of a 3D solid.

FILLETEDGE.description: Rounds and fillets the edges of solid objects.

FILTER.description: Creates a list of requirements that an object must meet to be included in a selection set.

FIND.description: Finds the text that you specify, and can optionally replace it with other text.

FINDINCLUDE.description: Controls the types of text objects included in a search when using the -FIND command.

FINDMATCH.description: Controls how the entered text string is compared with text in objects when using the -FIND command.

FLATSHOT.description: Creates a 2D representation of all 3D objects based on the current view.

FREESPOT.description: Creates a free spotlight which is a spotlight without a specified target.

FREEWEB.description: Creates a free web light which is a web light without a specified target.

GCCOINCIDENT.description: Constrains two points together or a point to a curve (or an extension of a curve).

GCCOLLINEAR.description: Causes two or more line segments to lie along the same line.

GCCONCENTRIC.description: Constrains two arcs, circles, or ellipses to the same center point.

GCEQUAL.description: Resizes selected arcs and circles to the same radius, or selected lines to the same length.

GCFIX.description: Locks points and curves in position.

GCHORIZONTAL.description: Causes lines or pairs of points to lie parallel to the X axis of the current coordinate system.

GCPARALLEL.description: Causes selected lines to lie parallel to each other.

GCPERPENDICULAR.description: Causes selected lines to lie 90 degrees to one another.

GCSMOOTH.description: Constrains a spline to be contiguous and maintain G2 continuity with another spline, line, arc, or polyline.

GCSYMMETRIC.description: Causes selected objects to become symmetrically constrained about a selected line.

GCTANGENT.description: Constrains two curves to maintain a point of tangency to each other or their extensions.

GCVERTICAL.description: Causes lines or pairs of points to lie parallel to the Y axis of the current coordinate system.

GEOGRAPHICLOCATION.description: Assigns geographic location information to a drawing file.

GEOMAP.description: Displays a map from an online maps service, in the current viewport.

GEOMAPIMAGE.description: Captures a portion of the online map to an object known as a map image, and embeds it in the drawing area.

GEOMAPIMAGEUPDATE.description: Updates map images from the online maps service and optionally resets their resolution for optimal on-screen viewing.

GEOMARKLATLONG.description: Places a position marker at a location defined by latitude and longitude.

GEOMARKME.description: Places a position marker in the drawing area at the coordinates corresponding to your current position.

GEOMARKPOINT.description: Places a position marker at a specified point in model space.

GEOMARKPOSITION.description: Places a position marker at a location you specify.

GEOMCONSTRAINT.description: Applies or persists geometric relationships between objects or points on objects.

GEOMETRYCLEANUPOPEN.description: Opens the Geometry Cleanup palette which displays potential gap, overshoot, undershoot, and angular errors for the current drawing.

GEOMETRYERRORREVIEWCLOSE.description: Exits the Geometry Cleanup review mode.

GEOREMOVE.description: Removes all geographic location information from the drawing file.

GEOREORIENTMARKER.description: Changes the north direction and position of the geographic marker in model space, without changing its latitude and longitude.

GOTOSTART.description: Switches from the current drawing to the Start tab.

GOTOURL.description: Opens the file or web page associated with the hyperlink attached to an object.

GRADIENT.description: Fills an enclosed area or selected objects with a gradient fill.

GRAPHICSCONFIG.description: Sets hardware acceleration on or off and provides access to display performance options.

GRAPHSCR.description: Causes the text window to display behind the application window.

GRID.description: Displays a grid pattern in the current viewport.

GROUP.description: Creates and manages saved sets of objects called groups.

GROUPEDIT.description: Adds and removes objects from the selected group, or renames a selected group.

HATCH.description: Fills an enclosed area or selected objects with a hatch pattern, solid fill, or gradient fill.

HATCHEDIT.description: Modifies an existing hatch or fill.

HATCHGENERATEBOUNDARY.description: Creates a non-associated polyline around a selected hatch.

HATCHSETBOUNDARY.description: Redefines a selected hatch or fill to conform to a different closed boundary.

HATCHSETORIGIN.description: Controls the starting location of hatch pattern generation for a selected hatch.

HATCHTOBACK.description: Sets the draw order for all hatches in the drawing to be behind all other objects.

HELP.description: Displays the online or offline Help system.

HIDE.description: Displays a 3D model with hidden lines suppressed for the 2D Wireframe visual style.

HIDEOBJECTS.description: Temporarily suppresses the display of selected objects.

HIDEPALETTES.description: Hides all displayed palettes, along with the ribbon and the drawing tabs.

HIGHLIGHTNEW.description: Controls whether new and changed features in product updates are highlighted in the user interface with an orange dot.

HLSETTINGS.description: Sets the display of such properties as hidden lines.

HYPERLINK.description: Attaches a hyperlink to an object or modifies an existing hyperlink.

HYPERLINKOPTIONS.description: Controls the display of the hyperlink cursor, tooltips, and shortcut menu.

ID.description: Displays the UCS coordinate values of a specified location.

IGESEXPORT.description: Saves selected objects in the current drawing to a new IGES (*.igs, *.iges) file.

IGESIMPORT.description: Imports data from an IGES (*.igs or *.iges) file into the current drawing.

IMAGEADJUST.description: Controls the brightness, contrast, and fade values of images.

IMAGEASYNCWAIT.description: Ensures that raster images being loaded in the background during file opening are complete before proceeding.

IMAGEATTACH.description: Inserts a reference to an image file.

IMAGECLIP.description: Crops the display of a selected image to a specified boundary.

IMAGEQUALITY.description: Controls the display quality of images.

IMPORT.description: Imports files of different formats into the current drawing.

IMPRINT.description: Imprints 2D geometry on a 3D solid or surface, creating additional edges on planar faces.

INPUTSEARCHOPTIONS.description: Opens a dialog box that controls settings for display of the command line suggestion list for commands, system variables, and named objects.

INSERT.description: Displays the Blocks palette, which you can use to insert blocks and drawings into the current drawing.

INSERTOBJ.description: Inserts a linked or embedded object.

INTERFERE.description: Creates a temporary 3D solid from the interferences between two sets of selected 3D solids.

INTERSECT.description: Creates a 3D solid, surface, or 2D region from overlapping solids, surfaces, or regions.

ISODRAFT.description: Turns isometric drafting settings on or off, and specifies the current 2D isometric drafting plane.

ISOLATEOBJECTS.description: Temporarily suppresses the display of all objects except those you select.

ISOPLANE.description: Specifies the current plane for 2D isometric drawing.

JOIN.description: Joins the endpoints of linear and curved objects to create a single object.

JPGOUT.description: Saves selected objects to a file in JPEG file format.

JUSTIFYTEXT.description: Changes the justification point of selected text objects without changing their locations.

LAYCUR.description: Changes the layer property of selected objects to the current layer.

LAYERP.description: Undoes the last change or set of changes made to layer settings.

LAYERPALETTE.description: Opens the modeless Layer Properties Manager.

LAYTHW.description: Thaws all layers in the drawing.

LAYTRANS.description: Translates the layers in the current drawing to specified layer standards.

LAYULK.description: Unlocks the layer of a selected object.

LIGHTLIST.description: Displays the Lights in Model palette that lists all lights in the model.

LWEIGHT.description: Sets the current lineweight, lineweight display options, and lineweight units.

MAKELISPAPP.description: Compiles one or more AutoLISP (LSP) source files into an application (VLX) file that can be distributed to users and protect your code.

MESHCOLLAPSE.description: Merges the vertices of selected mesh faces or edges.

MESHCREASE.description: Sharpens the edges of selected mesh subobjects.

MESHEXTRUDE.description: Extends a mesh face into 3D space.

MESHMERGE.description: Merges adjacent faces into a single face.

MESHOPTIONS.description: Displays the Mesh Tessellation Options dialog box, which controls default settings for converting existing objects to mesh objects.

MESHPRIMITIVEOPTIONS.description: Displays the Mesh Primitive Options dialog box, which sets the tessellation defaults for primitive mesh objects.

MESHSPLIT.description: Splits a mesh face into two faces.

MESHUNCREASE.description: Removes the crease from selected mesh faces, edges, or vertices.

MIGRATEMATERIALS.description: Finds any legacy materials in Tool Palettes and converts them to generic type.

MINSERT.description: Inserts multiple instances of a block in a rectangular array.

MIRROR.description: Creates a mirrored copy of selected objects.

MIRROR3D.description: Creates a mirrored copy of selected 3D objects across a mirroring plane.

MLEADERALIGN.description: Aligns and spaces selected multileader objects.

MLEADERCOLLECT.description: Organizes selected multileaders that contain blocks into rows or columns, and displays the result with a single leader.

MLEADEREDIT.description: Adds leader lines to, or removes leader lines from, a multileader object.

MLEDIT.description: Edits multiline intersections, breaks, and vertices.

MLSTYLE.description: Creates, modifies, and manages multiline styles.

MODEL.description: Switches from a named layout tab to the Model tab.

MOVE.description: Moves objects a specified distance in a specified direction.

NEWSHOT.description: Creates a named view with motion that is played back when viewed with ShowMotion.

OPENDWFMARKUP.description: Opens a DWF or DWFx file that contains markups.

ORTHO.description: Constrains cursor movement to the horizontal or vertical direction.

PCEXTRACTEDGE.description: Infers the intersection between two adjacent planar segments, and creates a line along the edge.

PCEXTRACTSECTION.description: Generates 2D geometry from a section through a point cloud.

PDFADJUST.description: Adjust the fade, contrast, and monochrome settings of a PDF underlay.

PDFATTACH.description: Inserts a PDF file as an underlay into the current drawing.

PDFLAYERS.description: Controls the display of layers in a PDF underlay.

PDFSHXTEXT.description: Converts the SHX geometry imported from PDF files into individual multiline text objects.

PSETUPIN.description: Imports a user-defined page setup into a new drawing layout.

QDIM.description: Creates a series of dimensions quickly from selected objects.

QLEADER.description: Creates a leader and leader annotation.

QNEW.description: Starts a new drawing from a specified drawing template file.

QSAVE.description: Saves the current drawing using the specified default file format.

QSELECT.description: Creates a selection set based on filtering criteria.

SOLPROF.description: Creates 2D profile images of 3D solids for display in a layout viewport.

SOLVIEW.description: Creates orthographic views, layers, and layout viewports automatically for 3D solids.

SPACETRANS.description: Calculates equivalent model space and paper space distances in a layout.

SPLINE.description: Creates a smooth curve that passes through or near a set of fit points, or that is defined by the vertices in a control frame.

SPLINEDIT.description: Modifies the parameters of a spline or converts a spline-fit polyline to a spline.

SPOTLIGHT.description: Creates a spotlight that emits a directional cone of light.

STANDARDS.description: Manages the association of standards files with drawings.

STATUS.description: Displays drawing statistics, modes, and extents.

STLOUT.description: Stores 3D solids and watertight meshes in a format that can be used with stereolithography apparatus.

STRETCH.description: Stretches objects crossed by a selection window or polygon.

STYLE.description: Creates, modifies, or specifies text styles.

STYLESMANAGER.description: Displays the Plot Style Manager, where you can revise plot style tables.

SUBTRACT.description: Creates as a new object by subtracting one overlapping region or 3D solid from another.

SURFBLEND.description: Creates a continuous blend surface between two existing surfaces.

SURFEXTEND.description: Lengthens a surface by a specified distance.

SURFEXTRACTCURVE.description: Creates curves on surfaces and 3D solids.

SURFFILLET.description: Creates a filleted surface between two other surfaces.

SURFNETWORK.description: Creates a surface in the space between several curves in the U and V directions, including surface and solid edge subobjects.

SURFOFFSET.description: Creates a parallel surface a specified distance from the original surface.

SURFPATCH.description: Creates a new surface by fitting a cap over a surface edge that forms a closed loop.

SURFSCULPT.description: Trims and combines a set of surfaces or meshes that completely enclose a volume to create a 3D solid.

SURFTRIM.description: Trims portions of a surface where it meets another surface or type of geometry.

SURFUNTRIM.description: Replaces surface areas removed by the SURFTRIM command.

SWEEP.description: Creates a 3D solid or 3D surface by sweeping a 2D object or subobject along an open or closed path.

SYSVARMONITOR.description: Monitors a list of system variables and sends notifications when there are changes to any one in the list.

SYSWINDOWS.description: Arranges windows and icons when the application window is shared with external applications.

TABLEDIT.description: Edits text in a table cell.

TABLEEXPORT.description: Exports data from a table object in CSV file format.

TABLESTYLE.description: Creates, modifies, or specifies table styles.

TABLET.description: Calibrates, configures, and turns on and off an attached digitizing tablet.

TABSURF.description: Creates a mesh from a line or curve that is swept along a straight path.

TASKBAR.description: Controls the Peek/Preview behavior of the application's button in the Windows taskbar when multiple drawings are open.

TEXTALIGN.description: Aligns multiple text objects vertically, horizontally, or obliquely.

TEXTEDIT.description: Edits a selected multiline or single-line text object, or the text in a dimension object.

TEXTSCR.description: Opens a text window that displays a history of prompts and command line entries for the current session.

TEXTTOFRONT.description: Brings text, leaders, and dimensions in front of all other objects in the drawing.

THICKEN.description: Converts a surface into a 3D solid with a specified thickness.

TIFOUT.description: Saves selected objects to a file in TIFF file format.

TIME.description: Displays the date and time statistics of a drawing.

TINSERT.description: Inserts a block in a table cell.

TOLERANCE.description: Creates geometric tolerances contained in a feature control frame.

TPNAVIGATE.description: Displays a specified tool palette or palette group.

TRACE.description: Opens and manages traces from the command prompt.

TRACEBACK.description: Changes the active trace to view mode so you can edit the parent drawing while the trace is still visible.

TRACEEDIT.description: Changes the active trace to edit mode so you can contribute to the trace.

TRACEFRONT.description: Changes the active trace to edit mode so you can contribute to the trace.

TRACEPALETTECLOSE.description: Closes the Trace palette where you view and manage traces in the current drawing.

TRACEPALETTEOPEN.description: Opens the Trace palette where you can view and manage traces in the current drawing.

TRACEVIEW.description: Changes the active trace to view mode so you can edit the parent drawing while the trace is still visible.

TRANSPARENCY.description: Controls whether background pixels in an image are transparent or opaque.

TRAYSETTINGS.description: Controls the display of icons and notifications in the status bar tray.

TREESTAT.description: Displays information about the drawing's current spatial index.

TRIM.description: Trims objects to meet the edges of other objects.

TXT2MTXT.description: Converts or combines single-line or multiline text objects into one or more multiline text objects.

UCS.description: Sets the origin and orientation of the current user coordinate system (UCS).

UCSICON.description: Controls the visibility, placement, appearance, and selectability of the UCS icon.

ULAYERS.description: Controls the display of layers in a DWF, DWFx, PDF, or DGN underlay.

UNDEFINE.description: Allows an application-defined command to override an internal command.

UNGROUP.description: Disassociates the objects from a group.

UNION.description: Combines two or more 3D solids, surfaces, or 2D regions into a single, composite 3D solid, surface, or region.

UNISOLATEOBJECTS.description: Displays objects previously hidden with the ISOLATEOBJECTS or HIDEOBJECTS command.

UNITS.description: Controls the precision and display formats for coordinates, distances, and angles.

UPDATETHUMBSNOW.description: Manually updates thumbnail previews for named views, drawings, and layouts.

VBALOAD.description: Loads a global VBA project into the current work session.

VBAMAN.description: Manages VBA project operations using a dialog box.

VBAPREF.description: Provides access to some of the VBA environment settings.

VBASTMT.description: Executes a VBA statement at the AutoCAD Command prompt.

VIEW.description: Saves and restores named model space views, layout views, and preset views.

VIEWBACK.description: Restores sequential views backward after changing the view.

VIEWBASE.description: Creates a base view from model space or Autodesk Inventor models.

VIEWCOMPONENT.description: Selects components from a model documentation drawing view for editing.

VIEWDETAIL.description: Creates a detail view of a portion of a model documentation drawing view.

VIEWDETAILSTYLE.description: Creates and modifies detail view styles.

VIEWEDIT.description: Edits an existing model documentation drawing view.

VIEWFORWARD.description: Restores sequential views forward after displaying a previous view with VIEWBACK or Zoom Previous.

VIEWPLAY.description: Plays the animation associated to a named view.

VIEWPLOTDETAILS.description: Displays information about completed plot and publish jobs.

VIEWPROJ.description: Creates one or more projected views from an existing model documentation drawing view.

VIEWRES.description: Sets the tessellation for objects in the current viewport when WHIPARC is turned off.

VIEWSECTION.description: Creates a section view of a 3D model that was created in AutoCAD or in Autodesk Inventor.

VIEWSECTIONSTYLE.description: Creates and modifies section view styles.

VIEWSETPROJ.description: Specifies the active project file for drawings containing model documentation drawing views from Inventor models.

VIEWSTD.description: Defines the default settings for model documentation drawing views.

VIEWSYMBOLSKETCH.description: Opens an editing environment so you can constrain section lines or detail boundaries to drawing view geometry.

VIEWUPDATE.description: Updates drawing views that have become out-of-date because the source model has changed.

VISUALSTYLES.description: Creates and modifies visual styles and applies a visual style to a viewport.

VPCLIP.description: Redefines a layout viewport object while retaining its properties.

VPMAX.description: Expands the current layout viewport for editing.

VPOINT.description: Sets the viewing direction for a 3D visualization of the drawing.

VPORTS.description: Creates multiple viewports in model space or in a layout (paper space).

VSCURRENT.description: Sets the visual style in the current viewport.

VSLIDE.description: Displays an image slide file in the current viewport.

VSSAVE.description: Saves the current visual style under a new name.

VTOPTIONS.description: Displays a change in view as a smooth transition.

WALKFLYSETTINGS.description: Controls the walk and fly navigation settings.

WBLOCK.description: Saves selected objects or converts a block to a specified drawing file.

WEBLIGHT.description: Creates a precise 3D representation of the light intensity distribution of a light source.

WEBLOAD.description: Loads a JavaScript file from a URL, and then executes the JavaScript code contained in the file.

WHOHAS.description: Displays information about an open drawing file.

WIPEOUT.description: Creates a wipeout object, and controls whether wipeout frames are displayed in the drawing.

WMFOUT.description: Saves objects to a Windows metafile.

WORKSPACE.description: Creates, modifies, and saves workspaces and makes a workspace current.

XATTACH.description: Attaches selected DWG files as external references (xrefs).

XBIND.description: Binds one or more definitions of named objects in an xref to the current drawing.

XCLIP.description: Crops the display of a selected external reference or block reference to a specified boundary.

XCOMPARE.description: Compares an attached xref with the latest state of the referenced drawing file, highlighting the differences with color within revision clouds.

XCOMPARECLOSE.description: Closes the Xref Compare toolbar and ends the comparison.

XCOMPARERCNEXT.description: Zooms to the next change set of the xref comparison result.

XCOMPARERCPREV.description: Zooms to the previous change set of the xref comparison result.

XEDGES.description: Creates wireframe geometry from the edges of a 3D solid, surface, mesh, region, or subobject.

XLINE.description: Creates a construction line of infinite length.

XOPEN.description: Opens a selected drawing reference (xref) in a new window.

XPLODE.description: Breaks a compound object into its component objects, with specified properties for the resulting objects.

ZOOM.description: Increases or decreases the magnification of the view in the current viewport.
